page.overview:
Who is Forst Bolin?

Forst Bolin was a doppler who ran a hostel, but only so he could murder and rob patrons. When the townspeople began to realize what he was doing, he quickly ran away and a bounty was put out for him to be brought in alive so he could be tried for his crimes.

In his attempt to escape, he took on the guise of a young woman, Jayne. However, this proved to not work in his favor as a troll in the area, Rockstride, caught the doppler and began to take "her" back to his home, believing that Jayne would dance for his wife and make her happy and not yell anymore.

Fortunately for Forst, Geralt and Ciri were traveling through on their way to Novigrad and saw what was happening. Geralt stepped in and persuaded the troll to release his captive and Forst, staying in his Jayne disguise, took up Ciri's offer to tag along with them to Novigrad.

That night, when asked about her past, Jayne explained she grew up outside Mulbrydale but found village life boring and eventually rode off to see the world. After they all went to sleep though, a werewolf snuck up and grabbed Geralt's swords and Jayne, intending to kill all of them. However, it hadn't noticed Ciri had been hiding, and the witchers quickly dispatched of the werewolf with Jayne only surprised at having another monster encounter.
